package cutpurse

// render_home.gno — the front door. One pitch, one thing to do, the board.
// A stranger must be able to start a job without scrolling.

import "strings"

func renderHome() string {
	var b strings.Builder
	b.WriteString(title("Cutpurse"))
	b.WriteString("**Four strangers rob the same cellar in the dark. Each picks in secret. " +
		"One of them is on the take.**\n\n")
	b.WriteString("Three rounds. Commit, then reveal. The snitch walks out with 60% of a busted pot.\n\n")

	open := jobList(0, 40)
	b.WriteString(nav("Rules", self("rules"), "Ledger", self("ledger"), "Stats", self("stats")) + "\n")
	b.WriteString(notice("NOTE", "", plural(int64(len(open)), "job")+" open. A seat costs what its creator set; "+
		"the pot is held by the realm, not by them."))

	b.WriteString("## Start a job\n\n")
	b.WriteString("You name it and put up one seat's fee. That fee is escrowed, not spent: " +
		"it comes back with the pot when the job settles.\n\n")
	b.WriteString("<gno-form exec=\"CreateJob\">\n")
	b.WriteString(`<gno-input name="name" placeholder="Cellar job, like Monday's take" description="Job name" required="true" />` + "\n")
	b.WriteString(`<gno-input name="fee" type="number" value="100000" description="Your seat's fee in ugnot (100000 = 0.1 GNOT)" required="true" />` + "\n")
	b.WriteString("</gno-form>\n\n")

	b.WriteString("> [!TIP] The one thing worth knowing before you sign\n")
	b.WriteString("> Your pick is hidden until the round ends, so nobody can copy it. ")
	b.WriteString("Open " + md("the rules", self("rules")) + " until the commit step makes sense. Three minutes.\n\n")

	b.WriteString("## Open jobs\n\n")
	if len(open) == 0 {
		b.WriteString(notice("NOTE", "No job is open. Be the first through the door.",
			"Fill the form above. A second wallet joining is enough to start."))
	} else {
		b.WriteString(jobTable(open))
		b.WriteString("\nAll of them → " + md("the board", self("jobs")) + "\n\n")
	}

	b.WriteString("## How a job runs\n\n")
	b.WriteString(cards(
		"### 1. Fill the seats\nA job takes 2 to 4 players. The creator kicks anyone "+
			"they do not want before it starts; a kicked seat is refunded in full.\n",
		"### 2. Pick in secret\nYou pick an action and commit `sha256(action|salt|you|job|round)`. "+
			"The page does the arithmetic. Nobody can see what you chose until the reveal.\n",
		"### 3. Pay out\nThree rounds, then the pot splits by contribution — unless the alarm "+
			"hits 3 and the job busts. Then only secured loot is paid, and the snitch takes 60%.\n",
	))

	b.WriteString(fold("One of the four is the snitch", ""+
		"The seat is sealed at the end of round one and only becomes visible at settlement.\n\n"+
		"Until then every seat carries the same "+segLocked+" "+segLocked+" "+segLocked+" "+segLocked+". "+
		"A bust pays the snitch 60% of the pot; an escape pays the snitch nothing extra.\n\n"+
		"Read the "+md("rules", self("rules"))+" before you bet on anyone.\n"))

	b.WriteString(notice("WARNING", "Bets are real GNOT on a testnet",
		"Nothing here is audited for mainnet. Play what you can afford to lose."))

	b.WriteString(nav("The board", self("jobs"), "Every settled job", self("ledger")))
	return b.String()
}

package cutpurse

// render_rules.gno — the whole game, once. Written for a player who is about
// to risk money, so every number is stated rather than implied.

import "strings"

func renderRules() string {
	var b strings.Builder
	b.WriteString(pageHead("Rules",
		"Four seats, three rounds, one snitch. Read once, then "+md("start a job", self(""))+".", "Home", hub))
	b.WriteString(notice("NOTE", "Everything below is enforced by the realm",
		"The alarm, the deadline and the payout split are arithmetic, not manners. "+
			"Nobody — including the job's creator — can move a coin before settlement."))

	b.WriteString("## The job\n\n")
	b.WriteString("A job is four seats in one cellar. Seats fill for 50 minutes; a job needs 2 players " +
		"to start and may run with fewer than 4. Everyone puts up the same fee, so the pot is " +
		"`fee × seats` and it sits in the realm until the job ends.\n\n")
	b.WriteString(notice("NOTE", "Why the seats may stay empty",
		"An unfilled job is harder and pays the same per seat. Do not wait for strangers if the fee is good."))

	b.WriteString("## The three rounds\n\n")
	b.WriteString(cards(
		"### Commit\nYou pick in secret. The page hashes your pick with a salt and posts only the hash. "+
			"200 blocks.\n",
		"### Reveal\nYou post the pick and the salt. The realm checks them against your hash. "+
			"150 blocks. A pick that is never revealed counts as "+actionCell(4)+" and costs you a reputation point.\n",
		"### Resolve\nLoot and alarm move together. Unless the job busted or this was round three, "+
			"the next round opens.\n",
	))

	b.WriteString("## The four actions\n\n")
	b.WriteString("Each round every player picks one in secret. Contribution is what the pot is split by.\n\n")
	b.WriteString("| Action | Contribution | Loot | Alarm |\n|---:|---:|---:|---:|\n")
	b.WriteString("| " + actionCell(1) + " | 2 | +2 | — |\n")
	b.WriteString("| " + actionCell(2) + " | 3 | +3 | +1 |\n")
	b.WriteString("| " + actionCell(3) + " | 3 | +3 secured | — |\n")
	b.WriteString("| " + actionCell(4) + " | 1 + alarm | +1 | −1 |\n\n")

	b.WriteString("### Alarm\n\n")
	b.WriteString("Alarm climbs by `picks − watches`, never below zero, and the meter is " +
		alarmBars(0) + ". At 3 the cellar door slams: the job busts " +
		"and every point of loot that was not carried out is lost.\n\n")
	b.WriteString(notice("CAUTION", "Carry is the only loot that survives a bust",
		"Unsecured loot is worth nothing on a bust. If the alarm is at 2, "+actionCell(3)+
			" is worth more than "+actionCell(2)+"."))

	b.WriteString("## The snitch\n\n")
	b.WriteString("At the end of round one the realm seals a seed from every commit hash in the round and " +
		"takes the snitch seat from it. No one — no creator, no oracle, no house — can set or change it after that.\n\n")
	b.WriteString("> " + segLocked + " " + segLocked + " " + segLocked + " " + segLocked + " — the seat is among you until settlement\n\n")
	b.WriteString("On a **bust** the snitch takes 60% of the pot and the rest splits by contribution. " +
		"On an **escape** the snitch takes nothing extra. That is the whole deduction: " +
		"a snitch wants alarm, so watch who keeps picking while the meter is climbing.\n\n")

	b.WriteString("## Payout\n\n")
	b.WriteString("Escaped: 5% of secured loot goes to the treasury and the rest splits by contribution. " +
		"Busted: 60% to the snitch, the remainder by contribution. A rounding remainder goes to the " +
		"highest contributor. If everyone contributed nothing, the pot splits evenly.\n\n")

	b.WriteString("## Timeouts\n\n")
	b.WriteString("Deadlines are block heights. Anyone may nudge the clock with " +
		md("Tick", self("jobs")) + " — it is permissionless and pays nothing, so do it rather than wait.\n\n")
	b.WriteString("- [x] A commit that never reveals becomes " + actionCell(4) + ", auto, no contribution, −1 reputation\n")
	b.WriteString("- [x] A missing commit becomes " + actionCell(4) + " with no contribution\n")
	b.WriteString("- [ ] A reveal after the deadline is rejected (`e410`) — the page tells you before you sign\n\n")

	b.WriteString("## Verifying a pick\n\n")
	b.WriteString("The hash is `sha256(action|salt|your address|job id|round)`, hex. The commit page builds it " +
		"from your chosen action and shows the salt to keep. Check it yourself with any sha256 tool; " +
		"the realm recomputes it exactly on reveal and rejects a mismatch (`e409`).\n\n")
	b.WriteString(notice("TIP", "Copy the salt when you commit",
		"Your seat page hands it back on the reveal step. Without it your pick cannot be proven."))

	b.WriteString(button("Read the board", self("jobs"), "") + " " +
		button("Start a job", self(""), "outline") + "\n\n")
	b.WriteString(nav("Home", self(""), "Every settled job", self("ledger")))
	return b.String()
}

package cutpurse

const (
	Denom = "ugnot"

	// SPEC §4 domain constants.
	Seats            = 4
	Rounds           = 3
	MinFee           = 100000
	MaxFee           = 5000000
	JoinBlocks       = 600
	CommitBlocks     = 200
	RevealBlocks     = 150
	BustAlarm        = 3
	TreasuryBps      = 500
	LiveJobsMax      = 40
	LedgerMax        = 500
	TraitorBustShare = 60

	// MaxSecured is the best possible Secured for a job: 2 per carry, every
	// round, every seat. The treasury cut scales against it so the 5% lands on
	// the pot instead of rounding to zero ugnot.
	MaxSecured = 2 * Seats * Rounds

	// write-time bounds
	MaxNameRunes = 40
	MaxSaltLen   = 64
	MaxListLimit = 50
)

type Phase uint8

const (
	PhaseOpen Phase = iota
	PhaseCommit
	PhaseReveal
	PhaseSettled
	PhaseBusted
)

type Action uint8

const (
	ActNone Action = iota
	ActScout
	ActPick
	ActCarry
	ActWatch
)

// Seat is one player slot. Revealed is derived: Action != ActNone.
type Seat struct {
	Addr         address
	Committed    bool
	CommitHash   string
	Action       Action
	Auto         bool
	Contribution int64
}

type Job struct {
	ID        int64
	Name      string
	Creator   address
	Fee       int64
	Pot       int64
	Phase     Phase
	Round     uint8
	Deadline  int64
	Seats     [Seats]Seat
	NSeats    uint8
	Alarm     int64
	Loot      int64
	Secured   int64
	Seed      string
	Traitor   int8
	Revealed  bool
	OpenedAt  int64
	SettledAt int64
}

// Result is a permanent ledger ring entry.
type Result struct {
	JobID   int64
	Name    string
	Busted  bool
	Loot    int64
	Traitor address
	At      int64
	Payouts string
}

type Stats struct {
	Jobs    int64
	Escapes int64
	Busts   int64
	Loot    int64
}

var (
	jobs       map[int64]*Job
	nextID     int64
	liveCount  int64
	active     map[address]int64
	ledger     [LedgerMax]*Result
	ledgerLen  int
	ledgerHead int
	treasury   int64
	// stats is keyed by the bech32 address string so that profile views can
	// look a player up in O(1) without a string->address parser (SPEC §4 says
	// map[address]*Stats; the key type is the only deviation, logged in STATE).
	stats map[string]*Stats
)

func init() {
	jobs = make(map[int64]*Job)
	active = make(map[address]int64)
	stats = make(map[string]*Stats)
}

package cutpurse

// render_rules.gno — the whole game, once. Written for a player who is about
// to risk money, so every number is stated rather than implied.

import "strings"

func renderRules() string {
	var b strings.Builder
	b.WriteString(pageHead("Rules",
		"Four seats, three rounds, one snitch. Read once, then "+md("start a job", self(""))+".", "Home", hub))
	b.WriteString(notice("NOTE", "Everything below is enforced by the realm",
		"The alarm, the deadline and the payout split are arithmetic, not manners. "+
			"Nobody — including the job's creator — can move a coin before settlement."))

	b.WriteString("## The job\n\n")
	b.WriteString("A job is four seats in one cellar. Seats fill for 50 minutes; a job needs 2 players " +
		"to start and may run with fewer than 4. Everyone puts up the same fee, so the pot is " +
		"`fee × seats` and it sits in the realm until the job ends.\n\n")
	b.WriteString(notice("NOTE", "Why the seats may stay empty",
		"An unfilled job is harder and pays the same per seat. Do not wait for strangers if the fee is good."))

	b.WriteString("## Paying in\n\n")
	b.WriteString("The fee rides the transaction, not a form. Only `CreateJob` and `JoinJob` read "+
		"the send envelope: send less than the fee and the call fails (`e413`), send more and the "+
		"excess is refunded in the same transaction.\n\n")
	b.WriteString("Every other call sends nothing — `Start`, `Kick`, `Commit`, `Reveal`, `Tick`, "+
		"`Settle` all fail if you attach coins. The `$help` page of each job prints the exact "+
		"command, send included.\n\n")

	b.WriteString("## The three rounds\n\n")
	b.WriteString(cards(
		"### Commit\nYou pick in secret. The page hashes your pick with a salt and posts only the hash. "+
			"200 blocks.\n",
		"### Reveal\nYou post the pick and the salt. The realm checks them against your hash. "+
			"150 blocks. A pick that is never revealed counts as "+actionCell(4)+" and costs you a reputation point.\n",
		"### Resolve\nLoot and alarm move together. Unless the job busted or this was round three, "+
			"the next round opens.\n",
	))

	b.WriteString("## The four actions\n\n")
	b.WriteString("Each round every player picks one in secret. Contribution is what the pot is split by.\n\n")
	b.WriteString("| Action | Contribution | Loot | Alarm |\n|---:|---:|---:|---:|\n")
	b.WriteString("| " + actionCell(1) + " | 2 | +2 | — |\n")
	b.WriteString("| " + actionCell(2) + " | 3 | +3 | +1 |\n")
	b.WriteString("| " + actionCell(3) + " | 3 | +3 secured | — |\n")
	b.WriteString("| " + actionCell(4) + " | 1 + alarm | +1 | −1 |\n\n")

	b.WriteString("### Alarm\n\n")
	b.WriteString("Alarm climbs by `picks − watches`, never below zero, and the meter is " +
		alarmBars(0) + ". At 3 the cellar door slams: the job busts " +
		"and every point of loot that was not carried out is lost.\n\n")
	b.WriteString(notice("CAUTION", "Carry is the only loot that survives a bust",
		"Unsecured loot is worth nothing on a bust. If the alarm is at 2, "+actionCell(3)+
			" is worth more than "+actionCell(2)+"."))

	b.WriteString("## The snitch\n\n")
	b.WriteString("At the end of round one the realm seals a seed from every commit hash in the round and " +
		"takes the snitch seat from it. No one — no creator, no oracle, no house — can set or change it after that.\n\n")
	b.WriteString("> " + segLocked + " " + segLocked + " " + segLocked + " " + segLocked + " — the seat is among you until settlement\n\n")
	b.WriteString("On a **bust** the snitch takes 60% of the pot and the rest splits by contribution. " +
		"On an **escape** the snitch takes nothing extra. That is the whole deduction: " +
		"a snitch wants alarm, so watch who keeps picking while the meter is climbing.\n\n")

	b.WriteString("## Payout\n\n")
	b.WriteString("Escaped: 5% of secured loot goes to the treasury and the rest splits by contribution. " +
		"Busted: 60% to the snitch, the remainder by contribution. A rounding remainder goes to the " +
		"highest contributor. If everyone contributed nothing, the pot splits evenly.\n\n")

	b.WriteString("## Timeouts\n\n")
	b.WriteString("Deadlines are block heights. Anyone may nudge the clock with " +
		md("Tick", self("jobs")) + " — it is permissionless and pays nothing, so do it rather than wait.\n\n")
	b.WriteString("- [x] A commit that never reveals becomes " + actionCell(4) + ", auto, no contribution, −1 reputation\n")
	b.WriteString("- [x] A missing commit becomes " + actionCell(4) + " with no contribution\n")
	b.WriteString("- [ ] A reveal after the deadline is rejected (`e410`) — the page tells you before you sign\n\n")

	b.WriteString("## Verifying a pick\n\n")
	b.WriteString("The hash is `sha256(action|salt|your address|job id|round)`, hex. The commit page builds it " +
		"from your chosen action and shows the salt to keep. Check it yourself with any sha256 tool; " +
		"the realm recomputes it exactly on reveal and rejects a mismatch (`e409`).\n\n")
	b.WriteString(notice("TIP", "Copy the salt when you commit",
		"Your seat page hands it back on the reveal step. Without it your pick cannot be proven."))

	b.WriteString(button("Read the board", self("jobs"), "") + " " +
		button("Start a job", self(""), "outline") + "\n\n")
	b.WriteString(nav("Home", self(""), "Every settled job", self("ledger")))
	return b.String()
}

const (
	Denom = "ugnot"

	// SPEC §4 domain constants.
	Seats            = 4
	Rounds           = 3
	MinFee           = 100000
	MaxFee           = 5000000
	JoinBlocks       = 600
	CommitBlocks     = 200
	RevealBlocks     = 150
	BustAlarm        = 3
	TreasuryBps      = 500
	LiveJobsMax      = 40
	LedgerMax        = 500
	TraitorBustShare = 60

	// MaxSecured is the best possible Secured for a job: 2 per carry, every
	// round, every seat. The treasury cut scales against it so the 5% lands on
	// the pot instead of rounding to zero ugnot.
	MaxSecured = 2 * Seats * Rounds

	// write-time bounds
	MaxNameRunes = 40
	MaxSaltLen   = 64
	MaxListLimit = 50
)

type Phase uint8

const (
	PhaseOpen Phase = iota
	PhaseCommit
	PhaseReveal
	PhaseSettled
	PhaseBusted
)

type Action uint8

const (
	ActNone Action = iota
	ActScout
	ActPick
	ActCarry
	ActWatch
)

// Seat is one player slot. Revealed is derived: Action != ActNone.
type Seat struct {
	Addr         address
	Committed    bool
	CommitHash   string
	Action       Action
	Auto         bool
	Contribution int64
}

type Job struct {
	ID        int64
	Name      string
	Creator   address
	Fee       int64
	Pot       int64
	Phase     Phase
	Round     uint8
	Deadline  int64
	Seats     [Seats]Seat
	NSeats    uint8
	Alarm     int64
	Loot      int64
	Secured   int64
	Seed      string
	Traitor   int8
	Revealed  bool
	OpenedAt  int64
	SettledAt int64
}

// Result is a permanent ledger ring entry.
type Result struct {
	JobID   int64
	Name    string
	Busted  bool
	Loot    int64
	Traitor address
	At      int64
	Payouts string
}

type Stats struct {
	Jobs    int64
	Escapes int64
	Busts   int64
	Loot    int64
}

	jobs       map[int64]*Job
	nextID     int64
	liveCount  int64

	ledgerLen  int
	ledgerHead int

	// stats is keyed by the bech32 address string so that profile views can
	// look a player up in O(1) without a string->address parser (SPEC §4 says
	// map[address]*Stats; the key type is the only deviation, logged in STATE).
	stats map[string]*Stats
)

func init() {
	jobs = make(map[int64]*Job)
	active = make(map[address]int64)
	stats = make(map[string]*Stats)
}

	keyB            = "2df04125f0015afb47ce853aef8772094ff9498c14cb1b9e12973c2927da0fa6"

package pool

import (
	"chain"
	"testing"

	mimir "gno.land/p/g12dcsmwccgdxasqde2eumua88tlrkw83kqf6tcz/mimir"
	"gno.land/p/nt/testutils/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/uassert/v0"
	"gno.land/r/g12dcsmwccgdxasqde2eumua88tlrkw83kqf6tcz/musd"
)

const (
	usd   = int64(1_000_000)
	block = int64(5) // seconds per test block
)

var (
	alice  = testutils.TestAddress("alice")
	bob    = testutils.TestAddress("bob")
	carol  = testutils.TestAddress("carol")
	dave   = testutils.TestAddress("dave")
	poolAt = chain.PackageAddress("gno.land/r/g12dcsmwccgdxasqde2eumua88tlrkw83kqf6tcz/pool")
)

// Each helper sets the acting user in its own frame, then calls.

func fund(cur realm, user address, amount int64) {
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(musd.Deployer))
	musd.Mint(cross(cur), user, amount)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(user))
	musd.Approve(cross(cur), poolAt, musd.Allowance(user, poolAt)+amount)
}

func open(cur realm, user address, side int, amount, closesIn int64) int64 {
	fund(cur, user, amount)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(user))
	return CreateMarket(cross(cur), "Will it rain?", "Yes", "No", "https://example.com", "World",
		now()+closesIn, side, "", amount)
}

func stake(cur realm, user address, id int64, side int, amount int64, referrer string) {
	fund(cur, user, amount)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(user))
	Stake(cross(cur), id, side, referrer, amount)
}

func asOracle(cur realm, id int64, outcome int, cutoff int64) {
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(InitialOracle))
	ResolveWithCutoff(cross(cur), id, outcome, "verdict", "", cutoff)
}

func claim(cur realm, user address, id int64) int64 {
	before := musd.BalanceOf(user)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(user))
	Claim(cross(cur), id)
	return musd.BalanceOf(user) - before
}

func skip(seconds int64) { testing.SkipHeights(seconds/block + 1) }

func TestStakeFeesAndProRataPayout(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	id := open(cur, alice, SideA, 100*usd, 3600)
	stake(cur, bob, id, SideB, 50*usd, "")
	a, b := SideTotals(id)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(99_500_000), a) // 0.5% entry fee
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(49_750_000), b)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(750_000), AccruedFees(Deployer))

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(InitialOracle))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "NotExpired", func() { Resolve(cross(cur), id, SideA, "x", "") })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "NotOracle", func() { Resolve(cross(cur), id, SideA, "x", "") })

	skip(3600)
	asOracle(cur, id, SideA, 0)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "NotResolved", func() { Claim(cross(cur), id) })
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "WindowOpen", func() { Finalize(cross(cur), id) })

	skip(DisputeWindow())
	Finalize(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(149_250_000), claim(cur, alice, id))
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "AlreadyClaimed", func() { Claim(cross(cur), id) })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "NothingToClaim", func() { Claim(cross(cur), id) })

	// The fee recipient pulls its entry fees.
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(Deployer))
	before := musd.BalanceOf(Deployer)
	ClaimFees(cross(cur))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(750_000), musd.BalanceOf(Deployer)-before)
}

func TestOneSidedAndDrawRefund(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	id := open(cur, alice, SideA, 10*usd, 3600)
	stake(cur, bob, id, SideA, 10*usd, "")
	skip(3600)
	asOracle(cur, id, SideA, 0)
	skip(DisputeWindow())
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))
	Finalize(cross(cur), id) // anyone
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(9_950_000), claim(cur, bob, id))

	id = open(cur, alice, SideA, 10*usd, 3600)
	stake(cur, bob, id, SideB, 10*usd, "")
	skip(3600)
	asOracle(cur, id, Draw, 0)
	skip(DisputeWindow())
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))
	Finalize(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(9_950_000), claim(cur, alice, id))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(9_950_000), claim(cur, bob, id))

func TestDisputeBondReturnedWhenRight(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	id := open(cur, alice, SideA, 10*usd, 3600)
	stake(cur, bob, id, SideB, 10*usd, "")
	skip(3600)
	asOracle(cur, id, SideA, 0)

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "NotParticipant", func() { Dispute(cross(cur), id) })

	fund(cur, bob, DisputeBond)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	Dispute(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "NotProposed", func() { Dispute(cross(cur), id) })
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "NotArbiter", func() { ResolveDispute(cross(cur), id, SideB, "x", "") })

	before := musd.BalanceOf(bob)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(InitialArbiter))
	ResolveDispute(cross(cur), id, SideB, "the arbiter disagrees", "")
	uassert.Equal(t, DisputeBond, musd.BalanceOf(bob)-before)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(19_900_000), claim(cur, bob, id))
}

func TestDisputeBondForfeitedWhenWrong(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	id := open(cur, alice, SideA, 10*usd, 3600)
	stake(cur, bob, id, SideB, 10*usd, "")
	skip(3600)
	asOracle(cur, id, SideA, 0)
	fund(cur, bob, DisputeBond)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	Dispute(cross(cur), id)
	feesBefore := AccruedFees(Deployer)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(InitialArbiter))
	ResolveDispute(cross(cur), id, SideA, "upheld", "")
	uassert.Equal(t, DisputeBond, AccruedFees(Deployer)-feesBefore)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(19_900_000), claim(cur, alice, id))
}

func TestSettlementCutoffRefundsLateDeposits(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	id := open(cur, alice, SideA, 10*usd, 3600)
	stake(cur, bob, id, SideB, 10*usd, "")
	skip(600)
	cutoff := now()
	skip(60)
	stake(cur, carol, id, SideB, 10*usd, "") // after the cutoff
	skip(3600)
	asOracle(cur, id, SideB, cutoff)
	a, b := EligibleTotals(id)

	uassert.Equal(t, int64(9_950_000), b)
	skip(DisputeWindow())
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(dave))

	uassert.Equal(t, int64(19_900_000), claim(cur, bob, id))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(9_950_000), claim(cur, carol, id)) // principal back

func TestRefundExpired(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	// Never resolved: a full refund after the grace.
	id := open(cur, alice, SideA, 10*usd, 3600)
	stake(cur, bob, id, SideB, 10*usd, "")
	skip(3600)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "GraceNotOver", func() { RefundExpired(cross(cur), id) })
	skip(ResolutionGraceSeconds)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(InitialOracle))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "GraceOver", func() { Resolve(cross(cur), id, SideA, "late", "") })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))
	RefundExpired(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(9_950_000), claim(cur, alice, id))

	// An unruled dispute settles to the proposal; the bond is forfeited.
	id = open(cur, alice, SideA, 10*usd, 3600)
	stake(cur, bob, id, SideB, 10*usd, "")
	skip(3600)
	asOracle(cur, id, SideA, 0)
	fund(cur, bob, DisputeBond)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	Dispute(cross(cur), id)
	skip(ResolutionGraceSeconds)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))
	RefundExpired(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(19_900_000), claim(cur, alice, id))
}

func TestVetoRefundsIfUnruled(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	id := open(cur, alice, SideA, 10*usd, 3600)

	skip(3600)
	asOracle(cur, id, SideA, 0)

	skip(ResolutionGraceSeconds)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))

	id := open(cur, alice, SideA, 10*usd, 3600)

	asOracle(cur, id, SideA, 0)
	skip(DisputeWindow())

	SetPaused(cross(cur), false)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(19_900_000), claim(cur, alice, id))

	id := open(cur, alice, SideB, 100*usd, 3600)

	skip(3600)
	asOracle(cur, id, SideA, 0)
	skip(DisputeWindow())
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))

	uassert.Equal(t, int64(199_000_000-1_990_000), claim(cur, bob, id))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(995_000), AccruedFees(dave)-refBefore)
}

func TestLimits(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	fund(cur, alice, 10*usd)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "StakeTooSmall", func() {
		CreateMarket(cross(cur), "q", "a", "b", "", "", now()+3600, SideA, "", MinStake-1)
	})
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "BadDeadline", func() {

	})
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "BadSide", func() {
		CreateMarket(cross(cur), "q", "a", "b", "", "", now()+3600, 3, "", MinStake)
	})

	// Betting closes LockSeconds before the deadline, or at an earlier lock.
	id := open(cur, alice, SideA, usd, 600)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "BadLock", func() { SetLockAt(cross(cur), id, now()+100) })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	SetLockAt(cross(cur), id, now()+100)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "BadLock", func() { SetLockAt(cross(cur), id, now()+200) })
	skip(100)
	fund(cur, bob, usd)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "BettingClosed", func() { Stake(cross(cur), id, SideB, "", usd) })

	// Caps gate new stakes only.
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(Deployer))
	SetCaps(cross(cur), 0, 5*usd)
	id = open(cur, alice, SideA, usd, 3600)
	fund(cur, bob, 10*usd)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "CapExceeded", func() { Stake(cross(cur), id, SideB, "", 10*usd) })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(Deployer))
	SetCaps(cross(cur), 0, 0)
}

func TestRolesAndTimelocks(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "NotOwner", func() { SetPaused(cross(cur), true) })

func fund(cur realm, user address, amount int64) {

func open(cur realm, user address, amount, closesIn int64, odds string, payoutBps int64, private bool) int64 {

	return CreateClaim(cross(cur), "BTC above 100k on Friday?", "Yes", "No", "https://example.com",
		now()+closesIn, amount, "Crypto", 0, "binary", odds, payoutBps, "", "", 0, private, "")

func challenge(cur realm, user address, id, amount int64, referrer string) {

func finalize(cur realm, id int64) {

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(dave))

func skip(seconds int64) { testing.SkipHeights(seconds/block + 1) }

func TestPoolOddsChallengersWin(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	id := open(cur, alice, 100*usd, 3600, "pool", 0, false)

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "AlreadyChallenged", func() { ChallengeClaim(cross(cur), id, usd, "") })

	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "NotOpen", func() { CancelClaim(cross(cur), id) })

	propose(cur, id, SideChallengers)
	b0, c0, a0 := musd.BalanceOf(bob), musd.BalanceOf(carol), musd.BalanceOf(alice)
	finalize(cur, id)
	// Creator 99.5 net; challengers 19.9 each; at risk = min(39.8*5, 99.5) = 99.5, split evenly.
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(19_900_000+49_750_000), musd.BalanceOf(bob)-b0)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(19_900_000+49_750_000), musd.BalanceOf(carol)-c0)

}

func TestFixedOddsReservesLiquidity(cur realm, t *testing.T) {

	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "CreatorHasInsufficientLiquidity", func() { ChallengeClaim(cross(cur), id, 10*usd, "") })
	challenge(cur, carol, id, 2*usd, "")
	skip(3600)
	propose(cur, id, SideChallengers)
	c0, a0 := musd.BalanceOf(carol), musd.BalanceOf(alice)
	finalize(cur, id)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(5_970_000), musd.BalanceOf(carol)-c0)           // 1.99 * 3
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(9_950_000-3_980_000), musd.BalanceOf(alice)-a0) // unreserved remainder
}

func TestCancelAndUnchallengedRefund(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	id := open(cur, alice, 5*usd, 3600, "pool", 0, false)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "NotCreator", func() { CancelClaim(cross(cur), id) })
	a0 := musd.BalanceOf(alice)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	CancelClaim(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(4_975_000), musd.BalanceOf(alice)-a0) // the entry fee stays earned
}

func TestPrivateInvites(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	id := open(cur, alice, 5*usd, 3600, "pool", 0, true)
	fund(cur, bob, usd)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "NotInvited", func() { ChallengeClaim(cross(cur), id, usd, "") })
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "BadInvite", func() { SetInvited(cross(cur), id, bob.String(), true) })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	SetInvited(cross(cur), id, bob.String()+", "+carol.String(), true)
	uassert.True(t, Invited(id, carol))
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	ChallengeClaim(cross(cur), id, usd, "")
	uassert.True(t, HasChallenged(id, bob))
}

func TestDisputeAndRuling(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	id := open(cur, alice, 10*usd, 3600, "pool", 0, false)
	challenge(cur, bob, id, 10*usd, "")
	skip(3600)
	propose(cur, id, SideCreator)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "NotAParticipant", func() { DisputeResolution(cross(cur), id) })
	fund(cur, bob, DisputeBond)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	DisputeResolution(cross(cur), id)
	b0 := musd.BalanceOf(bob)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(InitialArbiter))
	ResolveDisputeWithCutoff(cross(cur), id, SideChallengers, "overturned", 80, "", 0)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(19_900_000)+DisputeBond, musd.BalanceOf(bob)-b0)
}

func TestCutoffRefundsLateChallenger(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	id := open(cur, alice, 10*usd, 3600, "pool", 0, false)
	challenge(cur, bob, id, 10*usd, "")
	skip(600)
	cutoff := now()
	skip(60)
	challenge(cur, carol, id, 10*usd, "")
	skip(3600)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(InitialOracle))
	ResolveClaimWithCutoff(cross(cur), id, SideChallengers, "late entry excluded", 95, "", cutoff)
	_, eb := EligibleTotals(id)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(9_950_000), eb)
	b0, c0 := musd.BalanceOf(bob), musd.BalanceOf(carol)
	finalize(cur, id)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(19_900_000), musd.BalanceOf(bob)-b0)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(9_950_000), musd.BalanceOf(carol)-c0)
}

func TestRefundExpiredAndCopyFees(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	id := open(cur, alice, 10*usd, 3600, "pool", 0, false)
	challenge(cur, bob, id, 10*usd, "")
	skip(3600 + ResolutionGraceSeconds)
	a0, b0 := musd.BalanceOf(alice), musd.BalanceOf(bob)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))
	RefundExpired(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(9_950_000), musd.BalanceOf(alice)-a0)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(9_950_000), musd.BalanceOf(bob)-b0)

	// A copied winner pays 1% of profit to the referrer and 1% to the platform.
	id = open(cur, alice, 100*usd, 3600, "pool", 0, false)
	challenge(cur, bob, id, 100*usd, dave.String())
	skip(3600)
	propose(cur, id, SideChallengers)
	b0 = musd.BalanceOf(bob)
	r0 := AccruedFees(dave)

	uassert.Equal(t, int64(199_000_000-1_990_000), musd.BalanceOf(bob)-b0)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(995_000), AccruedFees(dave)-r0)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(dave))
	ClaimFees(cross(cur))
}

func TestRematchAndGuards(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	parent := open(cur, alice, 5*usd, 3600, "fixed", 15_000, false)
	fund(cur, bob, 5*usd)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	id := CreateRematch(cross(cur), parent, now()+7200, 5*usd)
	uassert.True(t, len(ClaimJSON(id)) > 0)
	uassert.True(t, len(ChallengersJSON(id)) >= 2)
	uassert.True(t, len(ClaimsJSON(0, 5)) > 2)
	uassert.True(t, len(Render("")) > 0)
	uassert.True(t, len(Render("1")) > 0)

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "PayoutTooHigh", func() {
		CreateClaim(cross(cur), "q", "a", "b", "", now()+3600, MinStake, "", 0, "", "fixed", 200_000, "", "", 0, false, "")
	})

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(Deployer))

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "IsPaused", func() { ChallengeClaim(cross(cur), parent, MinStake, "") })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(Deployer))
	SetPaused(cross(cur), false)
	skip(mimir.TimelockSeconds)
}

package cutpurse

// render_home.gno — the front door. One pitch, one thing to do, the board.
// A stranger must be able to start a job without scrolling.

import "strings"

func renderHome() string {
	var b strings.Builder
	b.WriteString(title("Cutpurse"))
	b.WriteString("**Four strangers rob the same cellar in the dark. Each picks in secret. " +
		"One of them is on the take.**\n\n")
	b.WriteString("Three rounds. Commit, then reveal. The snitch walks out with 60% of a busted pot.\n\n")

	open := jobList(0, 40)
	b.WriteString(nav("Rules", self("rules"), "Ledger", self("ledger"), "Stats", self("stats")) + "\n")
	b.WriteString(notice("NOTE", "", plural(int64(len(open)), "job")+" open. A seat costs what its creator set; "+
		"the pot is held by the realm, not by them."))

	b.WriteString("## Start a job\n\n")
	b.WriteString("You name it and put up one seat's fee. That fee is escrowed, not spent: " +
		"it comes back with the pot when the job settles.\n\n")
	b.WriteString("<gno-form exec=\"CreateJob\">\n")
	b.WriteString(`<gno-input name="name" placeholder="Cellar job, like Monday's take" description="Job name" required="true" />` + "\n")
	b.WriteString(`<gno-input name="fee" type="number" value="100000" description="Your seat's fee in ugnot (100000 = 0.1 GNOT)" required="true" />` + "\n")
	b.WriteString("</gno-form>\n\n")
	b.WriteString(sendFor(MinFee, "That is your own seat's fee, held in escrow; the fee field "+
		"below is clamped to the realm's range."))

	b.WriteString("> [!TIP] The one thing worth knowing before you sign\n")
	b.WriteString("> Your pick is hidden until the round ends, so nobody can copy it. ")
	b.WriteString("Open " + md("the rules", self("rules")) + " until the commit step makes sense. Three minutes.\n\n")

	b.WriteString("## Open jobs\n\n")
	if len(open) == 0 {
		b.WriteString(notice("NOTE", "No job is open. Be the first through the door.",
			"Fill the form above. A second wallet joining is enough to start."))
	} else {
		b.WriteString(jobTable(open))
		b.WriteString("\nAll of them → " + md("the board", self("jobs")) + "\n\n")
	}

	b.WriteString("## How a job runs\n\n")
	b.WriteString(cards(
		"### 1. Fill the seats\nA job takes 2 to 4 players. The creator kicks anyone "+
			"they do not want before it starts; a kicked seat is refunded in full.\n",
		"### 2. Pick in secret\nYou pick an action and commit `sha256(action|salt|you|job|round)`. "+
			"The page does the arithmetic. Nobody can see what you chose until the reveal.\n",
		"### 3. Pay out\nThree rounds, then the pot splits by contribution — unless the alarm "+
			"hits 3 and the job busts. Then only secured loot is paid, and the snitch takes 60%.\n",
	))

	b.WriteString(fold("One of the four is the snitch", ""+
		"The seat is sealed at the end of round one and only becomes visible at settlement.\n\n"+
		"Until then every seat carries the same "+segLocked+" "+segLocked+" "+segLocked+" "+segLocked+". "+
		"A bust pays the snitch 60% of the pot; an escape pays the snitch nothing extra.\n\n"+
		"Read the "+md("rules", self("rules"))+" before you bet on anyone.\n"))

	b.WriteString(notice("WARNING", "Bets are real GNOT on a testnet",
		"Nothing here is audited for mainnet. Play what you can afford to lose."))

	b.WriteString(nav("The board", self("jobs"), "Every settled job", self("ledger")))
	return b.String()
}

package cutpurse

// render_rules.gno — the whole game, once. Written for a player who is about
// to risk money, so every number is stated rather than implied.

import "strings"

func renderRules() string {
	var b strings.Builder
	b.WriteString(pageHead("Rules",
		"Four seats, three rounds, one snitch. Read once, then "+md("start a job", self(""))+".", "Home", hub))
	b.WriteString(notice("NOTE", "Everything below is enforced by the realm",
		"The alarm, the deadline and the payout split are arithmetic, not manners. "+
			"Nobody — including the job's creator — can move a coin before settlement."))

	b.WriteString("## The job\n\n")
	b.WriteString("A job is four seats in one cellar. Seats fill for 50 minutes; a job needs 2 players " +
		"to start and may run with fewer than 4. Everyone puts up the same fee, so the pot is " +
		"`fee × seats` and it sits in the realm until the job ends.\n\n")
	b.WriteString(notice("NOTE", "Why the seats may stay empty",
		"An unfilled job is harder and pays the same per seat. Do not wait for strangers if the fee is good."))

	b.WriteString("## Paying in\n\n")
	b.WriteString("The fee rides the transaction, not a form. Only `CreateJob` and `JoinJob` read "+
		"the send envelope: a call with no coins at all is `e403 not-user-call`, less than the "+
		"fee is `e413`, and anything over is refunded in the same transaction.\n\n")
	b.WriteString("Every other call sends nothing — `Start`, `Kick`, `Commit`, `Reveal`, `Tick`, "+
		"`Settle` all fail if you attach coins. The `$help` page of each job prints the exact "+
		"command, send included.\n\n")

	b.WriteString("## The three rounds\n\n")
	b.WriteString(cards(
		"### Commit\nYou pick in secret. The page hashes your pick with a salt and posts only the hash. "+
			"200 blocks.\n",
		"### Reveal\nYou post the pick and the salt. The realm checks them against your hash. "+
			"150 blocks. A pick that is never revealed counts as "+actionCell(4)+" and costs you a reputation point.\n",
		"### Resolve\nLoot and alarm move together. Unless the job busted or this was round three, "+
			"the next round opens.\n",
	))

	b.WriteString("## The four actions\n\n")
	b.WriteString("Each round every player picks one in secret. Contribution is what the pot is split by.\n\n")
	b.WriteString("| Action | Contribution | Loot | Alarm |\n|---:|---:|---:|---:|\n")
	b.WriteString("| " + actionCell(1) + " | 2 | +2 | — |\n")
	b.WriteString("| " + actionCell(2) + " | 3 | +3 | +1 |\n")
	b.WriteString("| " + actionCell(3) + " | 3 | +3 secured | — |\n")
	b.WriteString("| " + actionCell(4) + " | 1 + alarm | +1 | −1 |\n\n")

	b.WriteString("### Alarm\n\n")
	b.WriteString("Alarm climbs by `picks − watches`, never below zero, and the meter is " +
		alarmBars(0) + ". At 3 the cellar door slams: the job busts " +
		"and every point of loot that was not carried out is lost.\n\n")
	b.WriteString(notice("CAUTION", "Carry is the only loot that survives a bust",
		"Unsecured loot is worth nothing on a bust. If the alarm is at 2, "+actionCell(3)+
			" is worth more than "+actionCell(2)+"."))

	b.WriteString("## The snitch\n\n")
	b.WriteString("At the end of round one the realm seals a seed from every commit hash in the round and " +
		"takes the snitch seat from it. No one — no creator, no oracle, no house — can set or change it after that.\n\n")
	b.WriteString("> " + segLocked + " " + segLocked + " " + segLocked + " " + segLocked + " — the seat is among you until settlement\n\n")
	b.WriteString("On a **bust** the snitch takes 60% of the pot and the rest splits by contribution. " +
		"On an **escape** the snitch takes nothing extra. That is the whole deduction: " +
		"a snitch wants alarm, so watch who keeps picking while the meter is climbing.\n\n")

	b.WriteString("## Payout\n\n")
	b.WriteString("Escaped: 5% of secured loot goes to the treasury and the rest splits by contribution. " +
		"Busted: 60% to the snitch, the remainder by contribution. A rounding remainder goes to the " +
		"highest contributor. If everyone contributed nothing, the pot splits evenly.\n\n")

	b.WriteString("## Timeouts\n\n")
	b.WriteString("Deadlines are block heights. Anyone may nudge the clock with " +
		md("Tick", self("jobs")) + " — it is permissionless and pays nothing, so do it rather than wait.\n\n")
	b.WriteString("- [x] A commit that never reveals becomes " + actionCell(4) + ", auto, no contribution, −1 reputation\n")
	b.WriteString("- [x] A missing commit becomes " + actionCell(4) + " with no contribution\n")
	b.WriteString("- [ ] A reveal after the deadline is rejected (`e410`) — the page tells you before you sign\n\n")

	b.WriteString("## Verifying a pick\n\n")
	b.WriteString("The hash is `sha256(action|salt|your address|job id|round)`, hex. The commit page builds it " +
		"from your chosen action and shows the salt to keep. Check it yourself with any sha256 tool; " +
		"the realm recomputes it exactly on reveal and rejects a mismatch (`e409`).\n\n")
	b.WriteString(notice("TIP", "Copy the salt when you commit",
		"Your seat page hands it back on the reveal step. Without it your pick cannot be proven."))

	b.WriteString(button("Read the board", self("jobs"), "") + " " +
		button("Start a job", self(""), "outline") + "\n\n")
	b.WriteString(nav("Home", self(""), "Every settled job", self("ledger")))
	return b.String()
}

const (

	Seats            = 4
	Rounds           = 3
	MinFee           = 100000

	LedgerMax        = 500
	TraitorBustShare = 60

	// MaxSecured is the best possible Secured for a job: 2 per carry, every
	// round, every seat. The treasury cut scales against it so the 5% lands on
	// the pot instead of rounding to zero ugnot.
	MaxSecured = 2 * Seats * Rounds

	// write-time bounds
	MaxNameRunes = 40
	MaxSaltLen   = 64
	MaxListLimit = 50
)

type Phase uint8

const (
	PhaseOpen Phase = iota
	PhaseCommit
	PhaseReveal
	PhaseSettled
	PhaseBusted
)

type Action uint8

const (
	ActNone Action = iota
	ActScout
	ActPick
	ActCarry
	ActWatch
)

// Seat is one player slot. Revealed is derived: Action != ActNone.
type Seat struct {
	Addr         address
	Committed    bool
	CommitHash   string
	Action       Action
	Auto         bool
	Contribution int64
}

type Job struct {
	ID        int64
	Name      string
	Creator   address
	Fee       int64
	Pot       int64
	Phase     Phase
	Round     uint8
	Deadline  int64
	Seats     [Seats]Seat

	Alarm     int64
	Loot      int64
	Secured   int64
	Seed      string
	Traitor   int8
	Revealed  bool
	OpenedAt  int64
	SettledAt int64
}

// Result is a permanent ledger ring entry.
type Result struct {
	JobID   int64
	Name    string
	Busted  bool
	Loot    int64
	Traitor address
	At      int64
	Payouts string
}

type Stats struct {
	Jobs    int64
	Escapes int64
	Busts   int64
	Loot    int64
}

var (
	jobs       map[int64]*Job
	nextID     int64
	liveCount  int64
	active     map[address]int64
	ledger     [LedgerMax]*Result

	// look a player up in O(1) without a string->address parser (SPEC §4 says
	// map[address]*Stats; the key type is the only deviation, logged in STATE).
	stats map[string]*Stats
)

func init() {
	jobs = make(map[int64]*Job)
	active = make(map[address]int64)
	stats = make(map[string]*Stats)
}

files.body:
# HearthEscrow

**HearthEscrow** is a trustless milestone-escrow and arbiter-split realm built for Gno.land.

It lets two parties lock `ugnot` behind explicit milestone tranches (in basis points summing to 10,000), release funds incrementally as deliverables are approved, resolve disputes via an optional neutral arbiter with arbitrary percentage splits, and automatically unlock depositor refunds once a target block height passes — all inspectable live through `gnoweb`.

## Why HearthEscrow

Freelance bounties, DAO grants, and guild quests onchain usually fall into two extremes: full upfront trust or heavyweight multi-sig governance. HearthEscrow gives contributors and sponsors a self-contained, auditable escrow primitive in pure Gno with zero external dependencies beyond the standard library and `p/nt/*` utilities.

## Architecture

| File | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `types.gno` | Lifecycle statuses (`active`, `disputed`, `completed`, `resolved`, `refunded`), `Milestone`, `DisputeRecord`, `Escrow`, `Stats`, and safety bounds |
| `errors.gno` | Sentinel error values for every validation, auth, and state-transition guard |
| `escrow.gno` | Core crossing entrypoints, AVL storage (`escrows` + `addressIndex`), accounting invariants, and `chain.Emit` events |
| `render.gno` | `gnoweb` Markdown UI (`/`, `/?status=...`, `/escrow/<id>`, `/address/<addr>`) with dynamic realm path links and copy-pasteable `gnokey` snippets |
| `escrow_test.gno` | Full GnoVM unit test suite covering happy paths, dust-free math, disputes, deadline refunds, auth guards, and `Render()` views |

### Lifecycle State Machine

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Active: CreateEscrow (ugnot deposit)
    Active --> Active: SubmitMilestone / ApproveMilestone (partial)
    Active --> Completed: ApproveMilestone (final tranche)
    Active --> Disputed: OpenDispute (depositor or recipient)
    Disputed --> Resolved: ResolveDispute (arbiter bps split)
    Active --> Refunded: ClaimRefund (depositor, height >= deadline)
```

## Public Crossing API

- `CreateEscrow(cur realm, title string, recipient address, arbiter address, deadlineHeight int64, milestoneTitles string, milestoneBps string) uint64` — Locks the attached `ugnot` deposit into a new escrow. Pass `""` for `arbiter` if no arbiter is needed.
- `SubmitMilestone(cur realm, id uint64, milestoneIndex int, deliverable string)` — Recipient attaches a deliverable URI or note to a pending milestone.
- `ApproveMilestone(cur realm, id uint64, milestoneIndex int) int64` — Depositor approves a milestone (pending or submitted) and releases its `ugnot` tranche. Approving the final unapproved milestone sweeps any integer-division remainder so zero dust is ever trapped.
- `OpenDispute(cur realm, id uint64, reason string)` — Depositor or recipient freezes an active escrow for arbiter review.
- `ResolveDispute(cur realm, id uint64, recipientBps int64, resolutionNote string) (int64, int64)` — Arbiter splits all remaining locked funds between recipient (`recipientBps / 10000`) and depositor (the remainder).
- `ClaimRefund(cur realm, id uint64) int64` — Depositor reclaims remaining locked funds once `runtime.ChainHeight() >= deadlineHeight` (blocked while a dispute is open).

Read-only queries: `GetEscrow(id uint64) *Escrow`, `GetStats() Stats`, `GetAddressEscrowIDs(addr address) []uint64`, and `Render(path string) string`.

## Security Invariants

1. **Direct EOA guard on deposits:** `CreateEscrow` requires `cur.Previous().IsUserCall()` before reading `unsafe.OriginSend()`, preventing indirect `maketx run` or intermediate-realm coin-envelope confusion.
2. **Realm solvency check:** Every deposit verifies the realm's live `ugnot` balance is at least `stats.TotalLocked + amount`.
3. **Checks-Effects-Interactions (CEI):** Every payout and refund updates milestone/escrow status, balances, and protocol stats before calling `banker.SendCoins`.
4. **Overflow-safe & dust-free math:** Deposits are bounded by `math.MaxInt64 / 10000`, milestone basis points must be positive and sum to exactly `10000`, and the final milestone approval sweeps the exact remaining `ugnot`.
5. **Dispute protection:** An open dispute freezes the escrow — neither milestone approvals nor deadline refunds can bypass the arbiter.
6. **Zero-send protection:** `ResolveDispute` skips `SendCoins` for any side whose share is `0` (0 bps or 10,000 bps splits).

## `gnoweb` Routes

- `/` — Protocol dashboard with TVL locked, total released, status counts, filter bar (`All`, `Active`, `Disputed`, `Closed`), and escrow table.
- `/escrow/<id>` — Full escrow detail view with progress bar, party links, milestones table, dispute record, and ready-to-run `gnokey` commands.
- `/address/<addr>` — Per-address portfolio showing counts and volume across Depositor, Recipient, and Arbiter roles.

## Running Tests Locally

Requires the Gno CLI (`gno`) built from [gnolang/gno](https://github.com/gnolang/gno):

```bash
gno test -v .
```

If running against a local checkout of `gnolang/gno`, pass `-root-dir <path-to-gno-repo>`:

```bash
gno test -root-dir <path-to-gno-repo> -v .
```

## Example CLI Flow (`gnokey`)

```bash
# 1. Create a 2-milestone escrow with 1 GNOT (1,000,000 ugnot)
gnokey maketx call -pkgpath "gno.land/r/<your_user>/hearthescrow" \
  -func CreateEscrow -send 1000000ugnot \
  -args "Landing Page Build" -args <recipient_addr> -args <arbiter_addr> -args 500000 \
  -args "Wireframes,Production Build" -args "4000,6000" <depositor_key>

# 2. Recipient submits milestone 0
gnokey maketx call -pkgpath "gno.land/r/<your_user>/hearthescrow" \
  -func SubmitMilestone -args 1 -args 0 -args "https://example.com/wireframes" <recipient_key>

# 3. Depositor approves milestone 0 (releases 400,000 ugnot)
gnokey maketx call -pkgpath "gno.land/r/<your_user>/hearthescrow" \
  -func ApproveMilestone -args 1 -args 0 <depositor_key>
```

import "strings"

func renderHome() string {
	var b strings.Builder
	b.WriteString(title("Cutpurse"))
	b.WriteString("**Four strangers rob the same cellar in the dark. Each picks in secret. " +
		"One of them is on the take.**\n\n")
	b.WriteString("Three rounds. Commit, then reveal. The snitch walks out with 60% of a busted pot.\n\n")

	open := jobList(0, 40)
	b.WriteString(nav("Rules", self("rules"), "Ledger", self("ledger"), "Stats", self("stats")) + "\n")
	b.WriteString(notice("NOTE", "", plural(int64(len(open)), "job")+" open. A seat costs what its creator set; "+
		"the pot is held by the realm, not by them."))

	b.WriteString("## Start a job\n\n")
	b.WriteString("You name it and put up one seat's fee. That fee is escrowed, not spent: " +
		"it comes back with the pot when the job settles.\n\n")
	b.WriteString("<gno-form exec=\"CreateJob\">\n")
	b.WriteString(`<gno-input name="name" placeholder="Cellar job, like Monday's take" description="Job name" required="true" />` + "\n")
	b.WriteString(`<gno-input name="fee" type="number" value="100000" description="Your seat's fee in ugnot (100000 = 0.1 GNOT)" required="true" />` + "\n")
	b.WriteString("</gno-form>\n\n")
	b.WriteString(sendFor(MinFee, "That is your own seat's fee, held in escrow; the fee field "+
		"below is clamped to the realm's range."))

	b.WriteString("> [!TIP] The one thing worth knowing before you sign\n")
	b.WriteString("> Your pick is hidden until the round ends, so nobody can copy it. ")
	b.WriteString("Open " + md("the rules", self("rules")) + " until the commit step makes sense. Three minutes.\n\n")

	b.WriteString("## Open jobs\n\n")
	if len(open) == 0 {
		b.WriteString(notice("NOTE", "No job is open. Be the first through the door.",
			"Fill the form above. A second wallet joining is enough to start."))
	} else {
		b.WriteString(jobTable(open))
		b.WriteString("\nAll of them → " + md("the board", self("jobs")) + "\n\n")
	}

	b.WriteString("## How a job runs\n\n")
	b.WriteString(cards(
		"### 1. Fill the seats\nA job takes 2 to 4 players. The creator kicks anyone "+
			"they do not want before it starts; a kicked seat is refunded in full.\n",
		"### 2. Pick in secret\nYou pick an action and commit `sha256(action|salt|you|job|round)`. "+
			"The page does the arithmetic. Nobody can see what you chose until the reveal.\n",
		"### 3. Pay out\nThree rounds, then the pot splits by contribution — unless the alarm "+
			"hits 3 and the job busts. Then only secured loot is paid, and the snitch takes 60%.\n",
	))

		"The seat is sealed at the end of round one and only becomes visible at settlement.\n\n"+
		"Until then every seat carries the same "+segLocked+" "+segLocked+" "+segLocked+" "+segLocked+". "+
		"A bust pays the snitch 60% of the pot; an escape pays the snitch nothing extra.\n\n"+
		"Read the "+md("rules", self("rules"))+" before you bet on anyone.\n"))

	b.WriteString(notice("WARNING", "Bets are real GNOT on a testnet",
		"Nothing here is audited for mainnet. Play what you can afford to lose."))

	b.WriteString(nav("The board", self("jobs"), "Every settled job", self("ledger")))
	return b.String()
}

package cutpurse

// render_rules.gno — the whole game, once. Written for a player who is about
// to risk money, so every number is stated rather than implied.

import "strings"

func renderRules() string {
	var b strings.Builder
	b.WriteString(pageHead("Rules",
		"Four seats, three rounds, one snitch. Read once, then "+md("start a job", self(""))+".", "Home", hub))
	b.WriteString(notice("NOTE", "Everything below is enforced by the realm",
		"The alarm, the deadline and the payout split are arithmetic, not manners. "+
			"Nobody — including the job's creator — can move a coin before settlement."))

	b.WriteString("## The job\n\n")
	b.WriteString("A job is four seats in one cellar. Seats fill for 50 minutes; a job needs 2 players " +
		"to start and may run with fewer than 4. Everyone puts up the same fee, so the pot is " +
		"`fee × seats` and it sits in the realm until the job ends.\n\n")
	b.WriteString(notice("NOTE", "Why the seats may stay empty",
		"An unfilled job is harder and pays the same per seat. Do not wait for strangers if the fee is good."))

	b.WriteString("## Paying in\n\n")
	b.WriteString("The fee rides the transaction, not a form. Only `CreateJob` and `JoinJob` read "+
		"the send envelope: a call with no coins at all is `e403 not-user-call`, less than the "+
		"fee is `e413`, and anything over is refunded in the same transaction.\n\n")
	b.WriteString("Every other call sends nothing — `Start`, `Kick`, `Commit`, `Reveal`, `Tick`, "+
		"`Settle` all fail if you attach coins. The `$help` page of each job prints the exact "+
		"command, send included.\n\n")

	b.WriteString("## The three rounds\n\n")
	b.WriteString(cards(
		"### Commit\nYou pick in secret. The page hashes your pick with a salt and posts only the hash. "+
			"200 blocks.\n",
		"### Reveal\nYou post the pick and the salt. The realm checks them against your hash. "+
			"150 blocks. A pick that is never revealed counts as "+actionCell(4)+" and costs you a reputation point.\n",
		"### Resolve\nLoot and alarm move together. Unless the job busted or this was round three, "+
			"the next round opens.\n",
	))

	b.WriteString("## The four actions\n\n")
	b.WriteString("Each round every player picks one in secret. Contribution is what the pot is split by.\n\n")
	b.WriteString("| Action | Contribution | Loot | Alarm |\n|---:|---:|---:|---:|\n")
	b.WriteString("| " + actionCell(1) + " | 2 | +2 | — |\n")
	b.WriteString("| " + actionCell(2) + " | 3 | +3 | +1 |\n")
	b.WriteString("| " + actionCell(3) + " | 3 | +3 secured | — |\n")
	b.WriteString("| " + actionCell(4) + " | 1 + alarm | +1 | −1 |\n\n")

	b.WriteString("### Alarm\n\n")
	b.WriteString("Alarm climbs by `picks − watches`, never below zero, and the meter is " +
		alarmBars(0) + ". At 3 the cellar door slams: the job busts " +
		"and every point of loot that was not carried out is lost.\n\n")
	b.WriteString(notice("CAUTION", "Carry is the only loot that survives a bust",
		"Unsecured loot is worth nothing on a bust. If the alarm is at 2, "+actionCell(3)+
			" is worth more than "+actionCell(2)+"."))

	b.WriteString("## The snitch\n\n")
	b.WriteString("At the end of round one the realm seals a seed from every commit hash in the round and " +
		"takes the snitch seat from it. No one — no creator, no oracle, no house — can set or change it after that.\n\n")
	b.WriteString("> " + segLocked + " " + segLocked + " " + segLocked + " " + segLocked + " — the seat is among you until settlement\n\n")
	b.WriteString("On a **bust** the snitch takes 60% of the pot and the rest splits by contribution. " +
		"On an **escape** the snitch takes nothing extra. That is the whole deduction: " +
		"a snitch wants alarm, so watch who keeps picking while the meter is climbing.\n\n")

	b.WriteString("## Payout\n\n")
	b.WriteString("Escaped: 5% of secured loot goes to the treasury and the rest splits by contribution. " +
		"Busted: 60% to the snitch, the remainder by contribution. A rounding remainder goes to the " +
		"highest contributor. If everyone contributed nothing, the pot splits evenly.\n\n")

	b.WriteString("## Timeouts\n\n")
	b.WriteString("Deadlines are block heights. Anyone may nudge the clock with " +
		md("Tick", self("jobs")) + " — it is permissionless and pays nothing, so do it rather than wait.\n\n")
	b.WriteString("- [x] A commit that never reveals becomes " + actionCell(4) + ", auto, no contribution, −1 reputation\n")
	b.WriteString("- [x] A missing commit becomes " + actionCell(4) + " with no contribution\n")
	b.WriteString("- [ ] A reveal after the deadline is rejected (`e410`) — the page tells you before you sign\n\n")

	b.WriteString("## Verifying a pick\n\n")
	b.WriteString("The hash is `sha256(action|salt|your address|job id|round)`, hex. The commit page builds it " +
		"from your chosen action and shows the salt to keep. Check it yourself with any sha256 tool; " +
		"the realm recomputes it exactly on reveal and rejects a mismatch (`e409`).\n\n")
	b.WriteString(notice("TIP", "Copy the salt when you commit",
		"Your seat page hands it back on the reveal step. Without it your pick cannot be proven."))

	b.WriteString(button("Read the board", self("jobs"), "") + " " +
		button("Start a job", self(""), "outline") + "\n\n")
	b.WriteString(nav("Home", self(""), "Every settled job", self("ledger")))
	return b.String()
}

package cutpurse

const (
	Denom = "ugnot"

	// SPEC §4 domain constants.
	Seats            = 4
	Rounds           = 3
	MinFee           = 100000
	MaxFee           = 5000000
	JoinBlocks       = 600
	CommitBlocks     = 200
	RevealBlocks     = 150
	BustAlarm        = 3
	TreasuryBps      = 500
	LiveJobsMax      = 40
	LedgerMax        = 500
	TraitorBustShare = 60

	// MaxSecured is the best possible Secured for a job: 2 per carry, every
	// round, every seat. The treasury cut scales against it so the 5% lands on
	// the pot instead of rounding to zero ugnot.
	MaxSecured = 2 * Seats * Rounds

	// write-time bounds
	MaxNameRunes = 40
	MaxSaltLen   = 64
	MaxListLimit = 50
)

type Phase uint8

const (
	PhaseOpen Phase = iota
	PhaseCommit
	PhaseReveal
	PhaseSettled
	PhaseBusted
)

type Action uint8

const (
	ActNone Action = iota
	ActScout
	ActPick
	ActCarry
	ActWatch
)

// Seat is one player slot. Revealed is derived: Action != ActNone.
type Seat struct {
	Addr         address
	Committed    bool
	CommitHash   string
	Action       Action
	Auto         bool
	Contribution int64
}

type Job struct {
	ID        int64
	Name      string
	Creator   address
	Fee       int64
	Pot       int64
	Phase     Phase
	Round     uint8
	Deadline  int64
	Seats     [Seats]Seat
	NSeats    uint8
	Alarm     int64
	Loot      int64
	Secured   int64
	Seed      string
	Traitor   int8
	Revealed  bool
	OpenedAt  int64
	SettledAt int64
}

// Result is a permanent ledger ring entry.
type Result struct {
	JobID   int64
	Name    string
	Busted  bool
	Loot    int64
	Traitor address
	At      int64
	Payouts string
}

type Stats struct {
	Jobs    int64
	Escapes int64
	Busts   int64
	Loot    int64
}

var (
	jobs       map[int64]*Job
	nextID     int64
	liveCount  int64
	active     map[address]int64
	ledger     [LedgerMax]*Result
	ledgerLen  int
	ledgerHead int
	treasury   int64
	// stats is keyed by the bech32 address string so that profile views can
	// look a player up in O(1) without a string->address parser (SPEC §4 says
	// map[address]*Stats; the key type is the only deviation, logged in STATE).
	stats map[string]*Stats
)

func init() {
	jobs = make(map[int64]*Job)
	active = make(map[address]int64)
	stats = make(map[string]*Stats)
}

	PhaseOpen Phase = iota
	PhaseCommit
	PhaseReveal
	PhaseSettled
	PhaseBusted

type Action uint8

	ActNone Action = iota
	ActScout
	ActPick
	ActCarry
	ActWatch

	Name      string
	Creator   address

	Pot       int64

	Round     uint8
	Deadline  int64
	Seats     [Seats]Seat

	Alarm     int64
	Loot      int64
	Secured   int64
	Seed      string
	Traitor   int8
	Revealed  bool
	OpenedAt  int64
	SettledAt int64
}

// Result is a permanent ledger ring entry.
type Result struct {
	JobID   int64
	Name    string
	Busted  bool
	Loot    int64
	Traitor address
	At      int64
	Payouts string
}

type Stats struct {
	Jobs    int64
	Escapes int64
	Busts   int64
	Loot    int64
}

	jobs       map[int64]*Job
	nextID     int64
	liveCount  int64
	active     map[address]int64
	ledger     [LedgerMax]*Result
	ledgerLen  int

}

package cutpurse

// render_home.gno — the front door. One pitch, one thing to do, the board.
// A stranger must be able to start a job without scrolling.

import "strings"

func renderHome() string {
	var b strings.Builder
	b.WriteString(title("Cutpurse"))
	b.WriteString("**Four strangers rob the same cellar in the dark. Each picks in secret. " +
		"One of them is on the take.**\n\n")
	b.WriteString("Three rounds. Commit, then reveal. The snitch walks out with 60% of a busted pot.\n\n")

	open := jobList(0, 40)
	b.WriteString(nav("Rules", self("rules"), "Ledger", self("ledger"), "Stats", self("stats")) + "\n")
	b.WriteString(notice("NOTE", "", plural(int64(len(open)), "job")+" open. A seat costs what its creator set; "+
		"the pot is held by the realm, not by them."))

	b.WriteString("## Start a job\n\n")
	b.WriteString("You name it and put up one seat's fee. That fee is escrowed, not spent: " +
		"it comes back with the pot when the job settles.\n\n")
	b.WriteString("<gno-form exec=\"CreateJob\">\n")
	b.WriteString(`<gno-input name="name" placeholder="Cellar job, like Monday's take" description="Job name" required="true" />` + "\n")
	b.WriteString(`<gno-input name="fee" type="number" value="100000" description="Your seat's fee in ugnot (100000 = 0.1 GNOT)" required="true" />` + "\n")
	b.WriteString("</gno-form>\n\n")
	b.WriteString(sendFor(MinFee, "That is your own seat's fee, held in escrow; the fee field "+
		"below is clamped to the realm's range."))

	b.WriteString("> [!TIP] The one thing worth knowing before you sign\n")
	b.WriteString("> Your pick is hidden until the round ends, so nobody can copy it. ")
	b.WriteString("Open " + md("the rules", self("rules")) + " until the commit step makes sense. Three minutes.\n\n")

	b.WriteString("## Open jobs\n\n")
	if len(open) == 0 {
		b.WriteString(notice("NOTE", "No job is open. Be the first through the door.",
			"Fill the form above. A second wallet joining is enough to start."))
	} else {
		b.WriteString(jobTable(open))
		b.WriteString("\nAll of them → " + md("the board", self("jobs")) + "\n\n")
	}

	b.WriteString("## How a job runs\n\n")
	b.WriteString(cards(
		"### 1. Fill the seats\nA job takes 2 to 4 players. The creator kicks anyone "+
			"they do not want before it starts; a kicked seat is refunded in full.\n",
		"### 2. Pick in secret\nYou pick an action and commit `sha256(action|salt|you|job|round)`. "+
			"The page does the arithmetic. Nobody can see what you chose until the reveal.\n",
		"### 3. Pay out\nThree rounds, then the pot splits by contribution — unless the alarm "+
			"hits 3 and the job busts. Then only secured loot is paid, and the snitch takes 60%.\n",
	))

	b.WriteString(fold("One of the four is the snitch", ""+
		"The seat is sealed at the end of round one and only becomes visible at settlement.\n\n"+
		"Until then every seat carries the same "+segLocked+" "+segLocked+" "+segLocked+" "+segLocked+". "+
		"A bust pays the snitch 60% of the pot; an escape pays the snitch nothing extra.\n\n"+
		"Read the "+md("rules", self("rules"))+" before you bet on anyone.\n"))

	b.WriteString(notice("WARNING", "Bets are real GNOT on a testnet",
		"Nothing here is audited for mainnet. Play what you can afford to lose."))

	b.WriteString(nav("The board", self("jobs"), "Every settled job", self("ledger")))
	return b.String()
}

package cutpurse

// render_rules.gno — the whole game, once. Written for a player who is about
// to risk money, so every number is stated rather than implied.

import "strings"

func renderRules() string {
	var b strings.Builder
	b.WriteString(pageHead("Rules",
		"Four seats, three rounds, one snitch. Read once, then "+md("start a job", self(""))+".", "Home", hub))
	b.WriteString(notice("NOTE", "Everything below is enforced by the realm",
		"The alarm, the deadline and the payout split are arithmetic, not manners. "+
			"Nobody — including the job's creator — can move a coin before settlement."))

	b.WriteString("## The job\n\n")
	b.WriteString("A job is four seats in one cellar. Seats fill for 50 minutes; a job needs 2 players " +
		"to start and may run with fewer than 4. Everyone puts up the same fee, so the pot is " +
		"`fee × seats` and it sits in the realm until the job ends.\n\n")
	b.WriteString(notice("NOTE", "Why the seats may stay empty",
		"An unfilled job is harder and pays the same per seat. Do not wait for strangers if the fee is good."))

	b.WriteString("## Paying in\n\n")
	b.WriteString("The fee rides the transaction, not a form. Only `CreateJob` and `JoinJob` read " +
		"the send envelope: a call with no coins at all is `e403 not-user-call`, less than the " +
		"fee is `e413`, and anything over is refunded in the same transaction.\n\n")
	b.WriteString("Every other call sends nothing — `Start`, `Kick`, `Commit`, `Reveal`, `Tick`, " +
		"`Settle` all fail if you attach coins. The `$help` page of each job prints the exact " +
		"command, send included.\n\n")

	b.WriteString("## The three rounds\n\n")
	b.WriteString(cards(
		"### Commit\nYou pick in secret. The page hashes your pick with a salt and posts only the hash. "+
			"200 blocks.\n",
		"### Reveal\nYou post the pick and the salt. The realm checks them against your hash. "+
			"150 blocks. A pick that is never revealed counts as "+actionCell(4)+" and costs you a reputation point.\n",
		"### Resolve\nLoot and alarm move together. Unless the job busted or this was round three, "+
			"the next round opens.\n",
	))

	b.WriteString("## The four actions\n\n")
	b.WriteString("Each round every player picks one in secret. Contribution is what the pot is split by.\n\n")
	b.WriteString("| Action | Contribution | Loot | Alarm |\n|---:|---:|---:|---:|\n")
	b.WriteString("| " + actionCell(1) + " | 2 | +2 | — |\n")
	b.WriteString("| " + actionCell(2) + " | 3 | +3 | +1 |\n")
	b.WriteString("| " + actionCell(3) + " | 3 | +3 secured | — |\n")
	b.WriteString("| " + actionCell(4) + " | 1 + alarm | +1 | −1 |\n\n")

	b.WriteString("### Alarm\n\n")
	b.WriteString("Alarm climbs by `picks − watches`, never below zero, and the meter is " +
		alarmBars(0) + ". At 3 the cellar door slams: the job busts " +
		"and every point of loot that was not carried out is lost.\n\n")
	b.WriteString(notice("CAUTION", "Carry is the only loot that survives a bust",
		"Unsecured loot is worth nothing on a bust. If the alarm is at 2, "+actionCell(3)+
			" is worth more than "+actionCell(2)+"."))

	b.WriteString("## The snitch\n\n")
	b.WriteString("At the end of round one the realm seals a seed from every commit hash in the round and " +
		"takes the snitch seat from it. No one — no creator, no oracle, no house — can set or change it after that.\n\n")
	b.WriteString("> " + segLocked + " " + segLocked + " " + segLocked + " " + segLocked + " — the seat is among you until settlement\n\n")
	b.WriteString("On a **bust** the snitch takes 60% of the pot and the rest splits by contribution. " +
		"On an **escape** the snitch takes nothing extra. That is the whole deduction: " +
		"a snitch wants alarm, so watch who keeps picking while the meter is climbing.\n\n")

	b.WriteString("## Payout\n\n")
	b.WriteString("Escaped: 5% of secured loot goes to the treasury and the rest splits by contribution. " +
		"Busted: 60% to the snitch, the remainder by contribution. A rounding remainder goes to the " +
		"highest contributor. If everyone contributed nothing, the pot splits evenly.\n\n")

	b.WriteString("## Timeouts\n\n")
	b.WriteString("Deadlines are block heights. Anyone may nudge the clock with " +
		md("Tick", self("jobs")) + " — it is permissionless and pays nothing, so do it rather than wait.\n\n")
	b.WriteString("- [x] A commit that never reveals becomes " + actionCell(4) + ", auto, no contribution, −1 reputation\n")
	b.WriteString("- [x] A missing commit becomes " + actionCell(4) + " with no contribution\n")
	b.WriteString("- [ ] A reveal after the deadline is rejected (`e410`) — the page tells you before you sign\n\n")

	b.WriteString("## Verifying a pick\n\n")
	b.WriteString("The hash is `sha256(action|salt|your address|job id|round)`, hex. The commit page builds it " +
		"from your chosen action and shows the salt to keep. Check it yourself with any sha256 tool; " +
		"the realm recomputes it exactly on reveal and rejects a mismatch (`e409`).\n\n")
	b.WriteString(notice("TIP", "Copy the salt when you commit",
		"Your seat page hands it back on the reveal step. Without it your pick cannot be proven."))

	b.WriteString(button("Read the board", self("jobs"), "") + " " +
		button("Start a job", self(""), "outline") + "\n\n")
	b.WriteString(nav("Home", self(""), "Every settled job", self("ledger")))
	return b.String()
}
